name: RBS Calculator
use_case: Design and predict RBS sequences for target expression levels
description: Predicts translation initiation rates from RBS and coding sequences. Most widely cited tool in iGEM for tuning protein expression in bacteria.

name: Benchling
description: Cloud platform for sequence design primer design codon optimization and lab notebook. Free for academic users. Official iGEM sponsor. Used by majority of iGEM teams.
output: Annotated plasmid maps / primers / lab records

name: SnapGene
description: Desktop tool for plasmid visualization Gibson/Golden Gate simulation and Sanger alignment. Wizard-driven cloning design with automatic primer suggestions. Free viewer available.

name: ApE (A Plasmid Editor)
use_case: Free plasmid editing and cloning simulation
description: Free desktop plasmid editor with built-in simulators for PCR Gibson restriction-ligation and Golden Gate assembly. No installation required on Mac.

name: NEBuilder
description: NEB's official Gibson Assembly design tool. Designs primers with correct overlaps for any combination of fragments automatically.

name: NEBCutter
description: Finds all restriction enzyme cut sites in a DNA sequence. Essential for restriction cloning and analytical digest planning.

name: COPASI
use_case: ODE-based modeling of genetic circuits and biochemical networks
description: Most widely used modeling tool in iGEM. Models promoter dynamics protein production and degradation as systems of ODEs. Graphical interface no coding required.

name: MATLAB
description: Commercial software offered free to iGEM teams. Used for ODE modeling signal processing and data fitting. Simulink extension for block-diagram circuit modeling.

name: Tellurium
description: Python library for SBML-based modeling of biological networks. Combines roadrunner simulation engine with Antimony model description language.

name: AlphaFold
description: DeepMind's revolutionary structure prediction tool. Predicts 3D protein structures from amino acid sequence with near-experimental accuracy. Database of 200M+ predicted structures.

name: ESMFold
description: Meta's protein language model for fast structure prediction. Useful for rapid screening of multiple variants. API available.

name: PyMOL
description: Industry-standard tool for visualizing and analyzing protein structures. Used in iGEM to present structural results and design binding interfaces. Educational license free.

name: CRISPOR
use_case: Guide RNA design and off-target scoring
description: Designs guide RNAs for any CRISPR system and scores off-target sites. Supports 100+ genomes and multiple Cas proteins.

name: Cas-OFFinder
description: Fast algorithm for finding all potential off-target sites for a given guide RNA. Essential for validating CRISPR specificity.

name: IDT OligoAnalyzer
use_case: Primer Tm and secondary structure analysis
description: Analyzes primer melting temperature hairpin formation and dimer formation. Used to validate primers before ordering.

name: Primer3
description: Classic primer design tool. Designs primers for PCR sequencing and hybridization with full control over Tm GC content and amplicon size.

name: NCBI BLAST
description: Searches sequence databases to find homologous sequences. Essential for verifying part sequences confirming gene identity and finding related proteins.

name: Clustal Omega
description: Aligns multiple DNA or protein sequences to identify conserved regions. Used in iGEM for comparing promoter variants or protein homologs.

name: SWISS-MODEL
description: Automated homology modeling server. Builds 3D protein models based on known template structures. Widely used when AlphaFold confidence is low.

name: Rosetta
description: Suite of algorithms for protein structure prediction design and modeling. Used in iGEM for enzyme design and protein engineering.

name: iGEM Parts Registry
description: Central repository of standard biological parts used in iGEM. Contains promoters RBS coding sequences and terminators with characterization data.

name: SynBioHub
description: Open-source repository for synthetic biology designs. Stores and shares genetic designs in SBOL format. Integrated with Benchling and other tools.

name: Addgene
description: Non-profit plasmid repository. Teams deposit and share plasmids. Extensive protocol library for standard molecular biology techniques.

name: iBioSim
description: Tool for modeling and simulation of genetic circuits using SBML. Integrates design verification and simulation in one environment.

name: BOOST
description: JBEI tool for codon optimization reverse translation and sequence verification against synthesis constraints like GC content and repeats.

name: Geneious Prime
description: Full-featured bioinformatics platform for sequence assembly alignment annotation and analysis. Offered free to iGEM teams alongside SnapGene.

name: WebLogo
description: Creates sequence logo diagrams showing conservation at each position in an alignment. Used to visualize promoter and RBS conservation.

name: protocols.io
description: Platform for writing sharing and versioning wet-lab protocols. Many iGEM teams publish their protocols here. DOI-citable.

name: Benchling CRISPR
description: Built-in CRISPR guide RNA design tool within Benchling. Scores guides for on-target efficiency and off-target risk. Integrated with sequence viewer.

name: UGENE
description: Free open-source alternative to Geneious. Handles NGS data assembly alignment and annotation. Cross-platform.

name: I-TASSER
description: Server for automated protein structure prediction and functional annotation. Consistently top-ranked in CASP competitions.

name: CRISPRscan
description: Predicts guide RNA efficiency using machine learning model trained on in vivo data. Used to rank guides before experimental validation.

name: Operon Calculator
description: Salis Lab tool for designing synthetic operons with predictable expression ratios between multiple genes in a single mRNA.

name: Serial Cloner
description: Free desktop-based tool for plasmid design and mapping. Simulates restriction digests and ligations. Good alternative to ApE.

name: CLC Genomics Workbench
description: Commercial platform for NGS data analysis. Used by iGEM teams for sequencing verification and genome assembly.

name: FPbase
description: Database of fluorescent protein properties including excitation/emission spectra brightness and photostability. Essential for choosing reporters.

name: Snapgene Viewer
description: Free version of SnapGene for opening and annotating plasmid files. Cannot simulate cloning but excellent for visualization.

name: Non-Repetitive Parts Calculator
description: Salis Lab tool for designing libraries of non-repetitive promoters RBS and other regulatory elements to avoid recombination.

name: MUSCLE
description: Fast and accurate multiple sequence alignment algorithm. Alternative to Clustal for large datasets.

name: MathWorks Simulink
use_case: Block diagram modeling of biological systems
description: Graphical environment for modeling dynamic systems. Used for genetic circuit simulation with visual block diagrams. Free for iGEM teams.
